title: Basic Investment Concepts and Asset Classes
content: Investment refers to the allocation of capital into financial assets with the expectation of generating income or capital appreciation over time. Core asset classes include: 1. Fixed Income (Fixed Deposits, Public Provident Fund, Debt Mutual Funds, Government Bonds) offering steady low-risk returns. 2. Equities (Direct Stocks, Equity Mutual Funds, ETFs) offering higher long-term growth potential accompanied by market risk. 3. Commodities (Physical Gold, Sovereign Gold Bonds, Silver) providing hedge against inflation. 4. Real Estate providing rental yield and asset appreciation.
